meta.title: The Deaf Gap
meta.grain: one row per Deaf people group
meta.measured: 73 sign languages · 120 people groups · 19.35M people. 68 languages / 90 groups / 17.53M with NOTHING found.
meta.compounding_problem: 31 of these carry PRIVATE-USE (q*) codes outside ISO 639-3. No resource pool indexes a private code, so their status is UNLOOKUPABLE — not measured absence. Folding them into "no resource" hides that the query itself is impossible.
meta.bridge_rule: A sign language is bridged ONLY by another sign language. This is why Deaf groups are excluded from city-bridge-opportunities rather than matched to a co-located spoken language.
meta.pools_caveat: eBible + JESUS Film only. GRN and FCBH audio are key-blocked — and audio would not serve this population regardless.
